images.alt_text: Rockford Air Duct Pros service van parked outside residential home in Rockford, IL
images.prompt: A clean white service van with company signage parked in front of a typical 1960s-1970s ranch-style brick home in a Midwest residential neighborhood. Mid-morning lighting, green lawn, mature trees. Professional appearance, realistic photo style. No text added beyond any visible on the van.

images.alt_text: Air duct technician cleaning supply register in Rolling Green neighborhood, Rockford, IL
images.prompt: A uniformed technician removing a ceiling supply air register in a residential home and vacuuming the duct boot with a HEPA vacuum. Clean, well-lit interior room, neutral wall colors, professional setting. Realistic photo, no text overlays.

images.alt_text: NADCA and BBB A Plus accreditation logos displayed for Rockford air duct cleaning company
images.prompt: A clean flat-lay or wall-mounted display showing NADCA member badge and BBB Accredited Business A+ badge on a neutral background. Professional, high resolution, no busy design. Simple credential display suitable for website trust section.
